{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
SENTINEL = -999.0

# Create a mask for sentinel values in baseline biomarker
sentinel_mask = data['biomarker_baseline'] == SENTINEL

# Create a cleaned dataset without sentinel values
clean_data = data[~sentinel_mask].copy()

# Check the shape of the clean data
print(f"Original data shape: {data.shape}")
print(f"Cleaned data shape: {clean_data.shape}")

# Check if the treatment arm is still imbalanced after removing sentinels
print("\nArm distribution after removing sentinels:")
print(clean_data['arm'].value_counts())

# Check severity distribution by arm
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm (cleaned):")
print(pd.crosstab(clean_data['arm'], clean_data['severity']))

# Check sex distribution by arm
print("\nSex distribution by arm (cleaned):")
print(pd.crosstab(clean_data['arm'], clean_data['sex']))

# Compute response rates by arm in cleaned data
response_rates_clean = clean_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by arm (cleaned):")
print(response_rates_clean)

# Compute response rates by severity in cleaned data
response_rates_severity = clean_data.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by severity (cleaned):")
print(response_rates_severity)

# Check if treatment arm is more severe in cleaned data
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm (cleaned, normalized):")
print(pd.crosstab(clean_data['arm'], clean_data['severity'], normalize='index'))"}
